packageRules.description: Pin TypeScript to ^6.0 until Angular supports TS 7. Angular 22 (incl. 22.1.0-next.6) declares peerDependency typescript >=6.0 <6.1; bumping to TS 7 breaks @angular/compiler-cli readConfiguration with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Error'). Revisit when an Angular release widens its typescript peer range to include 7.x.
